caption: The drawing shows three views of an iron trivet with ornate, openwork patterns. The trivet has a flat, elongated teardrop or leaf shape, with a handle-like extension at one end, and stands on three short legs. The main surface features a symmetrical, decorative design composed of curved and looping elements arranged in a floral pattern, all within the outline of the trivet. The object is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance. The drawing includes a top view, a side view, and a perspective view, as well as a scale under the side view marked in inches from 0 to 2. The background is plain and light in color, providing contrast with the darker trivet.
title: Flat Iron Holder
